data.narrative:
Zeromark is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Joel Anderson that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, all operating in the same sector and stage cohort.

Two triangulation methods apply to this analysis. Stage-progression uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. Peer-median analysis examines 5 directly comparable companies spanning Seed and Series A stages. The peer set ranges from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), with a median valuation of $1.0B. This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and technology differentiation within Defense & Security.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $21M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $512M. The gap between stage-progression ($25M) and peer-median ($1.0B) is substantial, reflecting uncertainty about whether Zeromark's technology and market position align with high-valued peers like UFORCE or nearer the lower end represented by earlier-stage comparables. Key uncertainties include product-market fit maturity, customer concentration, and defensibility of core IP relative to the peer set's established capabilities.
